article.story: Utah State (1-3) at No. 22 Boise State (3-1), Oct. 3 at 7:30 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Boise State by 21. Against the spread: Boise State 3-1, Utah State 2-2. How to watch: CBS Sports Network Key stats Boise State Offense Overall: 440.5 yards per game (37th in FBS) Passing: 203.5 yards per game (99th) Rushing: 237.0 yards per game (17th) Scoring: 33.8 points per game (54th) Boise State Defense Overall: 379.5 yards per game (102nd in FBS) Passing: 278.8 yards per game (131st) Rushing: 100.8 yards per game (34th) Scoring: 21.3 points per game (54th) Utah State Offense Overall: 319.8 yards per game (125th in FBS) Passing: 203.3 yards per game (100th) Rushing: 116.5 yards per game (119th) Scoring: 13.0 points per game (136th) Utah State Defense Overall: 368.0 yards per game (87th in FBS) Passing: 228.3 yards per game (95th) Rushing: 139.8 yards per game (80th) Scoring: 22.0 points per game (63rd) Utah State ranks 91st in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert 40.3% of the time. Boise State ranks 17th on offense, converting on 50.9% of third downs. Utah State ranks 136th in the FBS with a -7 turnover margin, compared to Boise State's 28th-ranked +3 margin. Utah State is 116th in the FBS averaging 72.8 penalty yards per game, compared to Boise State's 51st-ranked 52.3 per-game average. Utah State is 133rd in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 60.0% of trips. Boise State's red zone defense ranks 29th at 72.7%. Utah State is 123rd in the FBS with an average time of possession of 27:32, compared to Boise State's 1st-ranked average of 37:14. Team leaders Boise State Passing: Maddux Madsen, 814 yards, 9 TDs, 0 INTs, 63.1 completion percentage Rushing: Dylan Riley, 592 yards on 90 carries, 3 TDs Receiving: Rasean Jones, 271 yards on 18 catches, 1 TD Utah State Passing: Grady Brosterhous, 635 yards, 4 TDs, 6 INTs, 56.1 completion percentage Rushing: Brosterhous, 222 yards on 63 carries, 0 TDs Receiving: Eli Wood, 286 yards on 23 catches, 3 TDs Last game Boise State defeated Western Michigan 32-7 on Sept. 26. Madsen led Boise State with 204 yards on 16-of-23 passing (69.6%) for three touchdowns and no interceptions. He also carried the ball four times for 29 yards. Riley had 138 rushing yards on 28 carries and one touchdown, adding one reception for 15 yards. Matt Wagner had seven receptions for 94 yards and two touchdowns. Utah State won 21-10 over Troy on Sept. 26. Brosterhous led Utah State with 242 yards on 18-of-28 passing (64.3%) for two touchdowns and one interception. He also carried the ball 15 times for 89 yards. Javen Jacobs had 84 rushing yards on 14 carries and one touchdown, adding two receptions for 11 yards. Wood had seven receptions for 96 yards and one touchdown. Next game Boise State plays at Fresno State on Oct. 10. Utah State hosts Washington State on Oct. 9.
